nodes.nie.text.t: The lad hangs his head and hunches over the notebook. "Oh well. I'll walk back, if the stars allow."

nodes.s.text.t: A lad in a stained smock sits on a stone, holding a notebook like a newborn. "I'm Hieronim's apprentice, and I've lost my way. Will you take this to the apprentices' box at Starwatch? If the master found out I'd lost it, he'd have my hide."

nodes.zgoda.text.t: The lad pushes the notebook into your hands. "Don't open it! There are drawings of stars in there, and every one has a name."
